blocks.text:
name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'browser_ext/**'
      - 'scripts/build_browser_ext.sh'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + extension dart2js + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables
          # (resolves to the same SDK the floating channel picked today).
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Example app pub get
        # gh-1265 AC2: resolve against the committed lockfile.
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # the build fails without it.
      - name: Placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored too (real keys stay local). The
      # web build needs the file to compile: copy the tracked placeholder —
      # main.dart skips Firebase init for YOUR_* values, so the demo runs
      # without Analytics (as it always has).
      - name: Placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: Build web demo
        working-directory: flutter_app
        id: web_build
        run: >-
          flutter build web --release
          --base-href /app/
          --output ../build/pages/app

      # The vendored WASI interpreter assets are mobile-only (#1096 AC3):
      # assets/wasm/* loads exclusively through WasiSandboxShell
      # (env_factory_io.dart — Android/iOS); the web build compiles
      # env_factory_stub (wasm_run needs dart:ffi) and runs python/js/
      # sqlite from cdn.jsdelivr.net (web_interpreters_web.dart). ~47MB
      # of dead weight in the deploy root — prune post-build, flags
      # untouched. The extension/office panel builds prune the same set
      # inside their packaging scripts.
      - name: Prune mobile-only wasm interpreter assets (#1096 AC3)
        run: |
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh): fails loudly on
          # flutter_assets layout drift. assets/wasm (~47MB) is loaded
          # exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (mobile-only); the pub
          # package's own test fixtures (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB) ride
          # along as package assets nothing on the web app loads.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh build/pages/app/assets \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

      # The Chrome extension ships on the site too (download + load
      # unpacked): dart2js the SW agent and zip it — flutter is already on
      # PATH here and the script's --with-app embeds the same web build.
      - name: Build Chrome extension
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # The Office add-in ships on the site too (sideload from
      # fa1.dev/outlook/manifest.xml): the script validates the manifest,
      # builds the fa web app with the office host flag (the pane IS the
      # app, outlook/app/) and assembles build/pages/root/outlook/ in
      # place — BEFORE the assemble step, so the artifact dir persists
      # into the upload.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: |
          cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # gh-1476: the static GEO layer is generated at deploy time too (the
      # committed artifacts are the CI freshness pin; the deploy rebuilds
      # from the same sources so the two can never drift). Dep-free pure
      # Dart scripts — no `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          cp -R site/. build/pages/root/
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
    …

Interesting — the current pages.yml "Assemble" step copies `site/.` into `build/pages/root`. The builders `build_blog.dart` and `build_site.dart` write into `site/` in-tree before assembly. The directive wants: builder writes into `build/pages` directly, and assemble picks them up from there — "artifacts exist only inside build/pages, never in the tree".

Plan for pages.yml:
- Step "Build the static GEO layer": `dart scripts/build_blog.dart` (what does build_blog.dart do? It keeps site/blog/posts in sync with blog/posts? Let me read it) and `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root` — building directly into the artifact dir.
- Assemble step: instead of `cp -R site/. build/pages/root/` (which would copy the whole site tree), copy site/ first, then overlay generated? No — directive says artifacts exist only inside build/pages. So: Assemble copies the non-generated site files (styles, index.html, blog template, images, robots.txt, llms.txt...) — i.e. copy `site/.` (the tree, which now contains no generated artifacts since they're gitignored and not committed), then overlay the generated output from `build/pages/gen` (or wherever) — but careful: generated blog index.html must replace the template's marker block... Actually if the builder's `--out` writes the FULL rendered blog/index.html (with list substituted) to the out dir, and assemble copies site/. then copies the generated files over, final result = rendered. But "Assemble picks up the freshly built files (not repo paths)" — the reviewer wants assemble to not rely on repo paths for generated files.

Simplest robust design:
- `build_site.dart --out build/pages/root` writes generated files (blog/<slug>/index.html, docs/<slug>/index.html, blog/index.html rendered, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) into the out dir.
- pages.yml: run builders with `--out build/pages/root`, then Assemble: copy `site/.` into build/pages/root but exclude generated paths? No wait — if out dir already has generated files, copying site/. OVER it would... the template site/blog/index.html (markers, empty list) would overwrite the rendered one. Order matters: copy site/ first, then overlay generated. But reviewer explicitly said the artifacts must exist ONLY in build/pages, never in the tree — and assemble must pick up freshly built files not repo paths.

Alternative cleaner: `--out` writes a complete self-contained site tree (copy static assets + generated). I.e., builder's --out mode: copies all non-generated files from site/ into out, then writes generated artifacts. Then Assemble = `cp -R <out>/. build/pages/root/` or just point upload at out. Option B: builder --out assembles a complete tree itself (copies statics). More logic in builder; the crawler tests could then serve the out directly. If the builder --out produces a COMPLETE site (statics + generated), then crawl tests: build to temp dir in setUpAll, serve temp dir. Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Shard-manifest assert (issue #283, AC1/E4): proves a shard manifest
covers EXACTLY the intended suite before any test runs.

Checks (all must hold, each failure is loud):
    1. union of all shard selections == the full suite on disk
       (root/**/*_test.dart minus --exclude matches minus integration);
    2. pairwise intersection of shard selections is empty — a test file is
       executed by exactly ONE shard;
    3. zero excluded files (e.g. host-locked goldens) leak into any shard.

Run from the package whose test/ dir is being sharded:

    cd packages/fa_ui
    python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

Tag-scoped manifests (issue #931: the integration shards) pass --tags so
both the selection AND the expected suite derive from the same matcher:

    python3 scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        scripts/test_integration_shards.json --shards 3 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm

The --exclude-tag form (gh-1199 AC1) asserts the live boundary too: the
expected suite is tagged-minus-excluded, and any excluded-tag file
reaching a selection is a loud leak.

Delegates the actual selection to shard_files.py (same interpreter the CI
test step uses), so the assert can never drift from what CI really runs.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on any violation.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag


def full_suite(root: str, exclude: list, tag=None, exclude_tags=None) -> set:
    out = set()
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*_test.dart"), recursive=True):
        norm = path.replace(os.sep, "/")
        if any(x in norm for x in exclude):
            continue
        if tag is not None:
            # Tag-scoped manifest: the suite IS the tagged files (same
            # matcher the runtime selector bin-packs with).
            if not file_has_tag(path, tag):
                continue
        elif "/integration/" in norm:
            continue
        if exclude_tags and any(file_has_tag(path, t) for t in exclude_tags):
            continue  # gh-1199 AC1: the live boundary shrinks the suite
        out.add(norm)

name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'browser_ext/**'
      - 'scripts/build_browser_ext.sh'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + extension dart2js + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables
          # (resolves to the same SDK the floating channel picked today).
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Example app pub get
        # gh-1265 AC2: resolve against the committed lockfile.
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # the build fails without it.
      - name: Placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored too (real keys stay local). The
      # web build needs the file to compile: copy the tracked placeholder —
      # main.dart skips Firebase init for YOUR_* values, so the demo runs
      # without Analytics (as it always has).
      - name: Placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: Build web demo
        working-directory: flutter_app
        id: web_build
        run: >-
          flutter build web --release
          --base-href /app/
          --output ../build/pages/app

      # The vendored WASI interpreter assets are mobile-only (#1096 AC3):
      # assets/wasm/* loads exclusively through WasiSandboxShell
      # (env_factory_io.dart — Android/iOS); the web build compiles
      # env_factory_stub (wasm_run needs dart:ffi) and runs python/js/
      # sqlite from cdn.jsdelivr.net (web_interpreters_web.dart). ~47MB
      # of dead weight in the deploy root — prune post-build, flags
      # untouched. The extension/office panel builds prune the same set
      # inside their packaging scripts.
      - name: Prune mobile-only wasm interpreter assets (#1096 AC3)
        run: |
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh): fails loudly on
          # flutter_assets layout drift. assets/wasm (~47MB) is loaded
          # exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (mobile-only); the pub
          # package's own test fixtures (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB) ride
          # along as package assets nothing on the web app loads.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh build/pages/app/assets \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

      # The Chrome extension ships on the site too (download + load
      # unpacked): dart2js the SW agent and zip it — flutter is already on
      # PATH here and the script's --with-app embeds the same web build.
      - name: Build Chrome extension
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # The Office add-in ships on the site too (sideload from
      # fa1.dev/outlook/manifest.xml): the script validates the manifest,
      # builds the fa web app with the office host flag (the pane IS the
      # app, outlook/app/) and assembles build/pages/root/outlook/ in
      # place — BEFORE the assemble step, so the artifact dir persists
      # into the upload.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: |
          cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # gh-1476: the static GEO layer is generated at deploy time too (the
      # committed artifacts are the CI freshness pin; the deploy rebuilds
      # from the same sources so the two can never drift). Dep-free pure
      # Dart scripts — no `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          cp -R site/. build/pages/root/
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then

blocks.text:
Tool error (bash): # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Shard-manifest assert (issue #283, AC1/E4): proves a shard manifest
covers EXACTLY the intended suite before any test runs.

Checks (all must hold, each failure is loud):
    1. union of all shard selections == the full suite on disk
       (root/**/*_test.dart minus --exclude matches minus integration);
    2. pairwise intersection of shard selections is empty — a test file is
       executed by exactly ONE shard;
    3. zero excluded files (e.g. host-locked goldens) leak into any shard.

Run from the package whose test/ dir is being sharded:

    cd packages/fa_ui
    python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

Tag-scoped manifests (issue #931: the integration shards) pass --tags so
both the selection AND the expected suite derive from the same matcher:

    python3 scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        scripts/test_integration_shards.json --shards 3 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm

The --exclude-tag form (gh-1199 AC1) asserts the live boundary too: the
expected suite is tagged-minus-excluded, and any excluded-tag file
reaching a selection is a loud leak.

Delegates the actual selection to shard_files.py (same interpreter the CI
test step uses), so the assert can never drift from what CI really runs.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on any violation.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag


def full_suite(root: str, exclude: list, tag=None, exclude_tags=None) -> set:
    out = set()
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*_test.dart"), recursive=True):
        norm = path.replace(os.sep, "/")
        if any(x in norm for x in exclude):
            continue
        if tag is not None:
            # Tag-scoped manifest: the suite IS the tagged files (same
            # matcher the runtime selector bin-packs with).
            if not file_has_tag(path, tag):
                continue
        elif "/integration/" in norm:
            continue
        if exclude_tags and any(file_has_tag(path, t) for t in exclude_tags):
            continue  # gh-1199 AC1: the live boundary shrinks the suite
        out.add(norm)

Tool error (bash): # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Shard-manifest assert (issue #283, AC1/E4): proves a shard manifest
covers EXACTLY the intended suite before any test runs.

Checks (all must hold, each failure is loud):
    1. union of all shard selections == the full suite on disk
       (root/**/*_test.dart minus --exclude matches minus integration);
    2. pairwise intersection of shard selections is empty — a test file is
       executed by exactly ONE shard;
    3. zero excluded files (e.g. host-locked goldens) leak into any shard.

Run from the package whose test/ dir is being sharded:

    cd packages/fa_ui
    python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

Tag-scoped manifests (issue #931: the integration shards) pass --tags so
both the selection AND the expected suite derive from the same matcher:

    python3 scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        scripts/test_integration_shards.json --shards 3 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm

The --exclude-tag form (gh-1199 AC1) asserts the live boundary too: the
expected suite is tagged-minus-excluded, and any excluded-tag file
reaching a selection is a loud leak.

Delegates the actual selection to shard_files.py (same interpreter the CI
test step uses), so the assert can never drift from what CI really runs.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on any violation.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag


def full_suite(root: str, exclude: list, tag=None, exclude_tags=None) -> set:
    out = set()
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*_test.dart"), recursive=True):
        norm = path.replace(os.sep, "/")
        if any(x in norm for x in exclude):
            continue
        if tag is not None:
            # Tag-scoped manifest: the suite IS the tagged files (same
            # matcher the runtime selector bin-packs with).
            if not file_has_tag(path, tag):
                continue
        elif "/integration/" in norm:
            continue
        if exclude_tags and any(file_has_tag(path, t) for t in exclude_tags):
            continue  # gh-1199 AC1: the live boundary shrinks the suite
        out.add(norm)

name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'browser_ext/**'
      - 'scripts/build_browser_ext.sh'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + extension dart2js + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables
          # (resolves to the same SDK the floating channel picked today).
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Example app pub get
        # gh-1265 AC2: resolve against the committed lockfile.
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # the build fails without it.
      - name: Placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored too (real keys stay local). The
      # web build needs the file to compile: copy the tracked placeholder —
      # main.dart skips Firebase init for YOUR_* values, so the demo runs
      # without Analytics (as it always has).
      - name: Placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: Build web demo
        working-directory: flutter_app
        id: web_build
        run: >-
          flutter build web --release
          --base-href /app/
          --output ../build/pages/app

      # The vendored WASI interpreter assets are mobile-only (#1096 AC3):
      # assets/wasm/* loads exclusively through WasiSandboxShell
      # (env_factory_io.dart — Android/iOS); the web build compiles
      # env_factory_stub (wasm_run needs dart:ffi) and runs python/js/
      # sqlite from cdn.jsdelivr.net (web_interpreters_web.dart). ~47MB
      # of dead weight in the deploy root — prune post-build, flags
      # untouched. The extension/office panel builds prune the same set
      # inside their packaging scripts.
      - name: Prune mobile-only wasm interpreter assets (#1096 AC3)
        run: |
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh): fails loudly on
          # flutter_assets layout drift. assets/wasm (~47MB) is loaded
          # exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (mobile-only); the pub
          # package's own test fixtures (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB) ride
          # along as package assets nothing on the web app loads.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh build/pages/app/assets \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

      # The Chrome extension ships on the site too (download + load
      # unpacked): dart2js the SW agent and zip it — flutter is already on
      # PATH here and the script's --with-app embeds the same web build.
      - name: Build Chrome extension
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # The Office add-in ships on the site too (sideload from
      # fa1.dev/outlook/manifest.xml): the script validates the manifest,
      # builds the fa web app with the office host flag (the pane IS the
      # app, outlook/app/) and assembles build/pages/root/outlook/ in
      # place — BEFORE the assemble step, so the artifact dir persists
      # into the upload.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: |
          cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # gh-1476: the static GEO layer is generated at deploy time too (the
      # committed artifacts are the CI freshness pin; the deploy rebuilds
      # from the same sources so the two can never drift). Dep-free pure
      # Dart scripts — no `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          cp -R site/. build/pages/root/
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
    …

Plan for pages.yml:
- Step "Build the static GEO layer": `dart scripts/build_blog.dart` (what does build_blog.dart do? It keeps site/blog/posts in sync with blog/posts? Let me read it) and `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root` — building directly into the artifact dir.
- Assemble step: instead of `cp -R site/. build/pages/root/` (which would copy the whole site tree), copy site/ first, then overlay generated? No — directive says artifacts exist only inside build/pages. So: Assemble copies the non-generated site files (styles, index.html, blog template, images, robots.txt, llms.txt...) — i.e. copy `site/.` (the tree, which now contains no generated artifacts since they're gitignored and not committed), then overlay the generated output from `build/pages/gen` (or wherever) — but careful: generated blog index.html must replace the template's marker block... Actually if the builder's `--out` writes the FULL rendered blog/index.html (with list substituted) to the out dir, and assemble copies site/. then copies the generated files over, final result = rendered. But "Assemble picks up the freshly built files (not repo paths)" — the reviewer wants assemble to not rely on repo paths for generated files.

Simplest robust design:
- `build_site.dart --out build/pages/root` writes generated files (blog/<slug>/index.html, docs/<slug>/index.html, blog/index.html rendered, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) into the out dir.
- pages.yml: run builders with `--out build/pages/root`, then Assemble: copy `site/.` into build/pages/root but exclude generated paths? No wait — if out dir already has generated files, copying site/. OVER it would... the template site/blog/index.html (markers, empty list) would overwrite the rendered one. Order matters: copy site/ first, then overlay generated. But reviewer explicitly said the artifacts must exist ONLY in build/pages, never in the tree — and assemble must pick up freshly built files not repo paths.

Alternative cleaner: `--out` writes a complete self-contained site tree (copy static assets + generated). I.e., builder's --out mode: copies all non-generated files from site/ into out, then writes generated artifacts. Then Assemble = `cp -R <out>/. build/pages/root/` or just point upload at out. Hmm but site/app is gitignored and built separately by flutter into build/pages/app; assemble adds app, extension, outlook, app-store images.

Let me think about what "generate into build/pages without writing into the source tree" means concretely with minimal risk:

Option A (two-phase assemble):

Tool error (bash): # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Shard-manifest assert (issue #283, AC1/E4): proves a shard manifest
covers EXACTLY the intended suite before any test runs.

Checks (all must hold, each failure is loud):
    1. union of all shard selections == the full suite on disk
       (root/**/*_test.dart minus --exclude matches minus integration);
    2. pairwise intersection of shard selections is empty — a test file is
       executed by exactly ONE shard;
    3. zero excluded files (e.g. host-locked goldens) leak into any shard.

Run from the package whose test/ dir is being sharded:

    cd packages/fa_ui
    python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

Tag-scoped manifests (issue #931: the integration shards) pass --tags so
both the selection AND the expected suite derive from the same matcher:

    python3 scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        scripts/test_integration_shards.json --shards 3 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm

The --exclude-tag form (gh-1199 AC1) asserts the live boundary too: the
expected suite is tagged-minus-excluded, and any excluded-tag file
reaching a selection is a loud leak.

Delegates the actual selection to shard_files.py (same interpreter the CI
test step uses), so the assert can never drift from what CI really runs.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on any violation.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag


def full_suite(root: str, exclude: list, tag=None, exclude_tags=None) -> set:
    out = set()
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*_test.dart"), recursive=True):
        norm = path.replace(os.sep, "/")
        if any(x in norm for x in exclude):
            continue
        if tag is not None:
            # Tag-scoped manifest: the suite IS the tagged files (same
            # matcher the runtime selector bin-packs with).
            if not file_has_tag(path, tag):
                continue
        elif "/integration/" in norm:
            continue
        if exclude_tags and any(file_has_tag(path, t) for t in exclude_tags):
            continue  # gh-1199 AC1: the live boundary shrinks the suite
        out.add(norm)

      - name: dart test --coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})

            --file-reporter="json:test-results/dart-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \

blocks.text:
name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'browser_ext/**'
      - 'scripts/build_browser_ext.sh'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + extension dart2js + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables
          # (resolves to the same SDK the floating channel picked today).
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Example app pub get
        # gh-1265 AC2: resolve against the committed lockfile.
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # the build fails without it.
      - name: Placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored too (real keys stay local). The
      # web build needs the file to compile: copy the tracked placeholder —
      # main.dart skips Firebase init for YOUR_* values, so the demo runs
      # without Analytics (as it always has).
      - name: Placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: Build web demo
        working-directory: flutter_app
        id: web_build
        run: >-
          flutter build web --release
          --base-href /app/
          --output ../build/pages/app

      # The vendored WASI interpreter assets are mobile-only (#1096 AC3):
      # assets/wasm/* loads exclusively through WasiSandboxShell
      # (env_factory_io.dart — Android/iOS); the web build compiles
      # env_factory_stub (wasm_run needs dart:ffi) and runs python/js/
      # sqlite from cdn.jsdelivr.net (web_interpreters_web.dart). ~47MB
      # of dead weight in the deploy root — prune post-build, flags
      # untouched. The extension/office panel builds prune the same set
      # inside their packaging scripts.
      - name: Prune mobile-only wasm interpreter assets (#1096 AC3)
        run: |
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh): fails loudly on
          # flutter_assets layout drift. assets/wasm (~47MB) is loaded
          # exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (mobile-only); the pub
          # package's own test fixtures (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB) ride
          # along as package assets nothing on the web app loads.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh build/pages/app/assets \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

      # The Chrome extension ships on the site too (download + load
      # unpacked): dart2js the SW agent and zip it — flutter is already on
      # PATH here and the script's --with-app embeds the same web build.
      - name: Build Chrome extension
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # The Office add-in ships on the site too (sideload from
      # fa1.dev/outlook/manifest.xml): the script validates the manifest,
      # builds the fa web app with the office host flag (the pane IS the
      # app, outlook/app/) and assembles build/pages/root/outlook/ in
      # place — BEFORE the assemble step, so the artifact dir persists
      # into the upload.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: |
          cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # gh-1476: the static GEO layer is generated at deploy time too (the
      # committed artifacts are the CI freshness pin; the deploy rebuilds
      # from the same sources so the two can never drift). Dep-free pure
      # Dart scripts — no `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          cp -R site/. build/pages/root/
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
    …

Interesting — the current pages.yml "Assemble" step copies `site/.` into `build/pages/root`. The builders `build_blog.dart` and `build_site.dart` write into `site/` in-tree before assembly. The directive wants: builder writes into `build/pages` directly, and assemble picks them up from there — "artifacts exist only inside build/pages, never in the tree".

Plan for pages.yml:
- Step "Build the static GEO layer": `dart scripts/build_blog.dart` (what does build_blog.dart do? It keeps site/blog/posts in sync with blog/posts? Let me read it) and `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root` — building directly into the artifact dir.
- Assemble step: instead of `cp -R site/. build/pages/root/` (which would copy the whole site tree), copy site/ first, then overlay generated? No — directive says artifacts exist only inside build/pages. So: Assemble copies the non-generated site files (styles, index.html, blog template, images, robots.txt, llms.txt...) — i.e. copy `site/.` (the tree, which now contains no generated artifacts since they're gitignored and not committed), then overlay the generated output from `build/pages/gen` (or wherever) — but careful: generated blog index.html must replace the template's marker block... Actually if the builder's `--out` writes the FULL rendered blog/index.html (with list substituted) to the out dir, and assemble copies site/. then copies the generated files over, final result = rendered. But "Assemble picks up the freshly built files (not repo paths)" — the reviewer wants assemble to not rely on repo paths for generated files.

Simplest robust design:
- `build_site.dart --out build/pages/root` writes generated files (blog/<slug>/index.html, docs/<slug>/index.html, blog/index.html rendered, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) into the out dir.
- pages.yml: run builders with `--out build/pages/root`, then Assemble: copy `site/.` into build/pages/root but exclude generated paths? No wait — if out dir already has generated files, copying site/. OVER it would... the template site/blog/index.html (markers, empty list) would overwrite the rendered one. Order matters: copy site/ first, then overlay generated. But reviewer explicitly said the artifacts must exist ONLY in build/pages, never in the tree — and assemble must pick up freshly built files not repo paths.

Alternative cleaner: `--out` writes a complete self-contained site tree (copy static assets + generated). I.e., builder's --out mode: copies all non-generated files from site/ into out, then writes generated artifacts. Then Assemble = `cp -R <out>/. build/pages/root/` or just point upload at out. Hmm but site/app is gitignored and built separately by flutter into build/pages/app; assemble adds app, extension, outlook, app-store images.

Let me think about what "generate into build/pages without writing into the source tree" means concretely with minimal risk:

Option A (two-phase assemble):
1. `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/geo` → generated artifacts only, in build/pages/geo mirroring site-relative paths.
2. Assemble:

   But `cp -R site/.` would copy template site/blog/index.html over... order: site first, geo overlay second → rendered blog index wins. And generated files never in tree. The only wart: `cp -R site/.` also copies nothing generated since not committed. Good. But does the reviewer accept overlay? "Double-check the Assemble step picks up the freshly built files (not repo paths)" — yes, overlay from build/pages/geo satisfies that.

   Wart: llms-full.txt — robots.txt points at /llms-full.txt; generated into geo overlay → present in root. Good.

Option B: builder --out assembles a complete tree itself (copies statics). More logic in builder; the crawler tests could then serve the out directly. Actually — for tests, test/site/* currently serve from `site/` (need to check). With artifacts uncommitted, the crawl tests must build first. If the builder --out produces a COMPLETE site (statics + generated), then crawl tests: build to temp dir in setUpAll, serve temp dir. That's clean and matches CI: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out <tmp>` then `dart test/site/` with env var pointing at tmp.

      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done

          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null

          # build dir must stay byte-identical.

blocks.text:
Tool error (bash): # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Shard-manifest assert (issue #283, AC1/E4): proves a shard manifest
covers EXACTLY the intended suite before any test runs.

Checks (all must hold, each failure is loud):
    1. union of all shard selections == the full suite on disk
       (root/**/*_test.dart minus --exclude matches minus integration);
    2. pairwise intersection of shard selections is empty — a test file is
       executed by exactly ONE shard;
    3. zero excluded files (e.g. host-locked goldens) leak into any shard.

Run from the package whose test/ dir is being sharded:

    cd packages/fa_ui
    python3 ../../scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        ../../scripts/faui_test_shards.json --shards 3 --exclude golden

Tag-scoped manifests (issue #931: the integration shards) pass --tags so
both the selection AND the expected suite derive from the same matcher:

    python3 scripts/assert_shard_manifest.py \
        scripts/test_integration_shards.json --shards 3 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm

The --exclude-tag form (gh-1199 AC1) asserts the live boundary too: the
expected suite is tagged-minus-excluded, and any excluded-tag file
reaching a selection is a loud leak.

Delegates the actual selection to shard_files.py (same interpreter the CI
test step uses), so the assert can never drift from what CI really runs.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on any violation.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag


def full_suite(root: str, exclude: list, tag=None, exclude_tags=None) -> set:
    out = set()
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*_test.dart"), recursive=True):
        norm = path.replace(os.sep, "/")
        if any(x in norm for x in exclude):
            continue
        if tag is not None:
            # Tag-scoped manifest: the suite IS the tagged files (same
            # matcher the runtime selector bin-packs with).
            if not file_has_tag(path, tag):
                continue
        elif "/integration/" in norm:
            continue
        if exclude_tags and any(file_has_tag(path, t) for t in exclude_tags):
            continue  # gh-1199 AC1: the live boundary shrinks the suite
        out.add(norm)

blocks.text:
name: Pages

# Builds the Flutter web demo (flutter_app) into site/app and
# deploys the static landing (site/) to GitHub Pages. Pages source must be
# set to "GitHub Actions" in the repo settings.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'site/**'
      - 'blog/**'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'flutter_app/**'
      - 'packages/**'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'vendor/**'
      - 'browser_ext/**'
      - 'scripts/build_browser_ext.sh'
      - 'office_addin/**'
      - 'scripts/build_office_addin.sh'
      - 'scripts/build_site.dart'
      - 'scripts/site_markdown.dart'
      - '.github/workflows/pages.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# One deploy at a time; queued runs must not be cancelled mid-deploy.
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build landing + web demo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily website watcher's budget arithmetic (#351):
    # flutter web build + extension dart2js + add-in build + a Playwright
    # chromium boot smoke; historically ~15m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          # Same pinned SDK as ci.yml web-spa (#1100): fa1.dev and
          # fa-web-spa.zip must never drift onto different Flutter stables
          # (resolves to the same SDK the floating channel picked today).
          flutter-version: '3.47.x'
          channel: stable

      # gh-1275 AC3 (web leg): fail fast before the web build — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Example app pub get
        # gh-1265 AC2: resolve against the committed lockfile.
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # the build fails without it.
      - name: Placeholder .env for the example app
        run: touch [REDACTED:Credential File]

      # firebase_options.dart is gitignored too (real keys stay local). The
      # web build needs the file to compile: copy the tracked placeholder —
      # main.dart skips Firebase init for YOUR_* values, so the demo runs
      # without Analytics (as it always has).
      - name: Placeholder firebase_options.dart for the example app
        run: >-
          cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart
          flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart

      - name: Build web demo
        working-directory: flutter_app
        id: web_build
        run: >-
          flutter build web --release
          --base-href /app/
          --output ../build/pages/app

      # The vendored WASI interpreter assets are mobile-only (#1096 AC3):
      # assets/wasm/* loads exclusively through WasiSandboxShell
      # (env_factory_io.dart — Android/iOS); the web build compiles
      # env_factory_stub (wasm_run needs dart:ffi) and runs python/js/
      # sqlite from cdn.jsdelivr.net (web_interpreters_web.dart). ~47MB
      # of dead weight in the deploy root — prune post-build, flags
      # untouched. The extension/office panel builds prune the same set
      # inside their packaging scripts.
      - name: Prune mobile-only wasm interpreter assets (#1096 AC3)
        run: |
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh): fails loudly on
          # flutter_assets layout drift. assets/wasm (~47MB) is loaded
          # exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (mobile-only); the pub
          # package's own test fixtures (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB) ride
          # along as package assets nothing on the web app loads.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh build/pages/app/assets \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

      # The Chrome extension ships on the site too (download + load
      # unpacked): dart2js the SW agent and zip it — flutter is already on
      # PATH here and the script's --with-app embeds the same web build.
      - name: Build Chrome extension
        run: |
          dart pub get
          cd browser_ext/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_browser_ext.sh --with-app

      # The Office add-in ships on the site too (sideload from
      # fa1.dev/outlook/manifest.xml): the script validates the manifest,
      # builds the fa web app with the office host flag (the pane IS the
      # app, outlook/app/) and assembles build/pages/root/outlook/ in
      # place — BEFORE the assemble step, so the artifact dir persists
      # into the upload.
      - name: Build Office add-in
        run: |
          cd office_addin/dart && dart pub get && cd ../..
          bash scripts/build_office_addin.sh

      # gh-1476: the static GEO layer is generated at deploy time too (the
      # committed artifacts are the CI freshness pin; the deploy rebuilds
      # from the same sources so the two can never drift). Dep-free pure
      # Dart scripts — no `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          cp -R site/. build/pages/root/
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          BUILD_ID: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Bust the Flutter demo app's entry scripts so browsers never load a
          # stale flutter_bootstrap.js / helper bundle after a new deploy.
          sed -i -E 's|src="([^\"]+)"|src="\1?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/app/index.html
          # Bust the landing page's own CSS/JS and the demo-app iframe/link.
          sed -i -E 's|href="styles\.css"|href="styles.css?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="main\.js" defer|src="main.js?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" defer|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|src="\./app/"|src="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'"|g' build/pages/root/index.html
          sed -i -E 's|href="\./app/" target="_blank"|href="./app/index.html?v='"${BUILD_ID}"'" target="_blank"|g' build/pages/root/index.html

      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)
        run: |
          # Per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget per line (issue
          # inventory format). First run seeds web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv
          # in the workspace (--init-if-missing) — the step below uploads
          # them as a ride-along artifact; commit them to arm the web
          # gates. The extension zip is gated against the committed
          # cut-shape baseline (same file the release gate in
          # build-macos.yml uses).
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/app \
            --baseline scripts/size_budget/web-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          if [ -d build/pages/root/outlook/app ]; then
            python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check build/pages/root/outlook/app \
              --baseline scripts/size_budget/outlook-app.tsv --init-if-missing
          fi
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
    …
