blocks.text:
What happened: the auto-save committed my changes (including the trimmed blog-index template). Then — my later in-tree `dart scripts/build_site.dart` default run REGENERATED the rendered blog index in-tree (as designed, gitignored artifacts), which OVERWROTE site/blog/index.html with the rendered version! That's why the working tree shows index.html modified: the file now contains the rendered list again (unstaged modification of the committed template). Wait but the rendered index.html IS a generated artifact... should site/blog/index.html be gitignored too?? The directive said: remove "the rendered blog-index list (keep a template/marker if the index needs one)". So the template site/blog/index.html is committed with empty markers; the RENDERED version is a build product. But both live at the same path! In-tree local builds overwrite the template with the rendered version — polluting the working tree (it shows as modified, though not ignored). Options: 1. Accept: in-tree local builds dirty the template (dev must `git checkout site/blog/index.html` after). Ugly. 2. In-tree emit shouldn't write blog/index.html... but then local preview lacks the post list. 3. Make the template a separate file (e.g. site/blog/index.template.html) that the builder uses as input, and emit writes the rendered index.html. Then site/blog/index.html is fully generated (gitignore it), template committed at another path. But then a raw checkout served without building has no /blog/ index.html — acceptable? The deploy always builds. And /blog/ 404s on unbuilt local serve — but that's true for every generated page anyway. Hmm wait — but the whole site's other pages (index.html, widgets, etc.) are statics. /blog/ index being absent in a raw checkout is consistent with /blog// being absent. But careful: the builder currently reads `$root/site/blog/index.html` for markers — change to read `site/blog/index.template.html`? Hmm, that introduces a new convention. Alternatively keep markers in the committed file and DON'T write blog/index.html in-tree if it would... no, fragile. Option 3 variant with least churn: committed template stays at site/blog/index.html, and gitignore... can't ignore a tracked file. Actually — reconsider: does the in-tree default mode even need to exist? The directive's model: artifacts live at deploy/CI via --out; local dev can also use --out (e.g. `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out /tmp/site` or into site/ via --out site? hmm --out site would collide: _copyStaticSite(root, 'site') copies site/→site/ and writes blog/index.html rendered over the template — same pollution, plus skip logic prevents copying generated). The cleanest: **remove the in-tree default write of blog/index.html**? No... Alternative accepted design: keep in-tree mode (writes gitignored artifacts) but for blog/index.html specifically the file is TRACKED (template). Conflict is inherent: same path is both template (committed) and artifact (generated). The old PR had it committed as rendered artifact with markers — which the directive rejected ("rendered blog-index list" must go). So option 3 is right: introduce `site/blog/index.template.html` as the committed template; `site/blog/index.html` becomes fully generated → gitignore it; builder reads the template, writes rendered index.html. In-tree emit still writes rendered index.html (now gitignored, no pollution). Hmm wait — but then what does a plain static server of a raw checkout show at /blog/? 404 (or directory listing). Previously (before this PR) site/blog/index.html was a committed static page with the post list maintained by hand/build_blog? Let me check git history: before this PR, was site/blog/index.html committed? The PR diff added the markers... it modified site/blog/index.html (+ modifications). In the pre-PR repo, site/blog/index.html was committed (hand-maintained or build_blog-generated?). Check base version: git show HEAD~:site/blog/index.html? HEAD includes PR changes. The PR base — find merge-base. Meh. The pre-PR index.html was likely a static committed page (blog post listing) — part of the old site. If I gitignore site/blog/index.html now, the OLD committed static page gets removed from tree... The directive explicitly says: "the rendered blog-index list (keep a template/marker if the index needs one)" — i.e., remove the rendered list; keep a template. So: template at a path that doesn't clash. Decision: - New file: `site/blog/index.template.html` — committed, contains markers + empty `
`. - Builder: reads the template (buildSite), emits rendered `site/blog/index.html`. - `.gitignore`: add `site/blog/index.html`. - Remove `site/blog/index.html` from git (git rm --cached + delete? it gets regenerated at build; raw checkout lacks /blog/ page until built — consistent with all generated pages). Hmm wait — one more consideration: the crawl test "blog index lists posts without JS" serves the built tree ✓. And pages.yml --out build/pages/root: _copyStaticSite copies template (it's a static .html file at blog/index.template.html — copied ✓ harmless), generated index.html written ✓. But _copyStaticSite must NOT skip blog/index.html anymore... currently I don't skip it (only skipDirs + sitemap/llms-full) ✓ — and template gets copied too (fine, inert extra file in deploy? `index.template.html` would be deployed publicly — harmless but slightly untidy. Could skip it in copy: add skip for 'blog/index.template.html'? It'd remain accessible at /blog/index.template.html — no secret, fine. But tidier to skip. I'll skip it in _copyStaticSite. Wait, actually also: emitSite prune — `_generatedPageDirs` scans siteDir/blog for dirs with index.html — the template is a FILE, not dir ✓. In-tree emit: writes rendered site/blog/index.html (gitignored) ✓ no working-tree pollution. Also revert current polluted working tree: `git checkout -- site/blog/index.html`? The committed version (from auto-save) is my trimmed template. Then I need to MOVE it to index.template.html. Steps: 1. git show HEAD:site/blog/index.html → the trimmed template (verify). 2. Create site/blog/index.template.html from it. 3. git rm --cached site/blog/index.html (and delete file), add template. 4. Update .gitignore: add site/blog/index.html. 5. Check build_blog.dart or anything else referencing site/blog/index.html... grep. 9. Re-run tests + rebuild. After switching to template model, rebuild in-tree to verify. blocks.text:
# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

blocks.text:
# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

blocks.text:
# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

Two issues:

1. **"prunes stale generated pages already in the out dir"**: `pruned stale page: blog/2024-01-01-old/` ✓ but then ALSO `pruned stale page: blog/2026-01-02-one/` — the freshly written post page got pruned! Why? The prune checks `expectedPaths.any((p) => p.startsWith('$dir/'))` — dir is 'blog/2026-01-02-one', expectedPaths contains 'blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html'. `'blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html'.startsWith('blog/2026-01-02-one/')` → true. So it shouldn't prune... unless expectedPaths entries lack the prefix. Wait, in the --out case strip='site/', rel gives 'blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html' ✓.

Hmm wait — but `_generatedPageDirs(siteDir)` where siteDir='$base/site'... in the out test, base=outDir. But the OUTPUT was written to '$base/${rel(o)}' = out/blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html ✓. siteDir = out/site?? NO — base = outDir = out.path; siteDir = '$base/site' = out/site — but files are at out/blog! _generatedPageDirs scans out/site/blog — which doesn't exist... but the log shows pruning happened of blog/2026-01-02-one — so it scanned out/blog. That means siteDir was out/blog's parent... 

Oh wait — I see: my edit set `final siteDir = '$base/site';` — that's wrong for out mode now! In out mode, files land directly at $base/blog/..., so generated dirs scan should be at $base. And in-tree, at $root/site. So siteDir should be: outDir ?? '$root/site'. That's what I had before the last edit for siteDir, but the WRITE base must be $root (in-tree) vs $outDir (out). Let me re-fix: base=root (in-tree) / outDir (out) for writes; siteDir = outDir ?? '$root/site' for scanning.

2. **in-tree emit**: still failing at 557 (sitemap at ${root.path}/site/sitemap.xml). base=root, rel full path 'site/sitemap.xml' → writes $root/site/sitemap.xml ✓ should exist... but wait, prune may have deleted?? Prune scans siteDir='$base/site' = root/site, dirs found include 'blog/2026-01-02-one' (just written, has index.html ✓) expectedPaths = full 'site/blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html'; check `p.startsWith('$dir/')` → 'site/blog/...'.startsWith('blog/2026.../') → FALSE → prunes the fresh page! And sitemap? sitemap is a file, not pruned. But the failure is at 557 — the sitemap assertion... Expected true actual false. Hmm — sitemap.xml written at '$base/site/sitemap.xml'... 

wait no, in-tree: `File('$base/${rel(o)}')` = root + '/site/sitemap.xml' ✓. Unless... the fixture also has the stale dir prune... Let me think about why sitemap missing. OH — the previous test failure mode: these tests run in RANDOM order with a shared fixture per test (setUp per test, fresh temp root each). Hmm.

Wait, actually let me recheck: in-tree test — `site.emitSite(root: root.path, outputs: outputs)`. base = root.path. rel = 'site/sitemap.xml'. File: root/site/sitemap.xml written ✓. Then prune: siteDir = '$base/site'... in my CURRENT code after last edit: `final siteDir = '$base/site';` — for in-tree that's root/site ✓. dirs found: blog/2024-01-01-old (stale) and blog/2026-01-02-one (fresh). expectedPaths (strip empty) = 'site/blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html'. startsWith('blog/2026-01-02-one/') false → PRUNE fresh page. Test then checks `File('${root.path}/site/blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html').existsSync()` isTrue at line ~559 and sitemap at 557... 557 is sitemap — hmm expected true actual false?? 

Hold on, 557:9 — after format, line numbers shifted. sed showed line 556 = sitemap expect in previous read? Earlier read showed 554-556: expect sitemap at 556, then blog page at 557-560. Failure at 557:9 → the blog page assertion. OK consistent: fresh page pruned due to path mismatch.

And failure 1 (out prune test): siteDir='$base/site' = out/site — doesn't exist → no dirs found... but log showed pruning of blog/2026-01-02-one in the out test?? The log lines "pruned stale page: blog/2024-01-01-old/" and "blog/2026-01-02-one/" appeared right before in-tree test failure — order: the '❌ prunes stale' group printed, then appstore tests, then "pruned stale page: blog/2024-01-01-old/" + "pruned stale page: blog/2026-01-02-one/" — these are from the IN-TREE test run. So out test: no pruning at all (siteDir wrong), staleOut survived → fail. In-tree test: fresh page pruned (prefix mismatch) → fail at 557.

Fix: 
```dart
final siteDir = outDir ?? '$root/site';  // scan target
final base = outDir ?? root;             // write target
```
Writes: in-tree at root/site/... ✓; out at outDir/blog/... ✓. Scan: in-tree at root/site ✓; out at outDir ✓.

expectedPaths in out mode: stripped 'blog/...' matching dirs 'blog/...' ✓. In-tree: full 'site/blog/...' vs dirs 'blog/...' ✗ — mismatch again for in-tree! Because _generatedPageDirs(siteDir) returns dirs relative to siteDir ('blog/x'), while in-tree expectedPaths are root-relative ('site/blog/x/index.html').

Normalize: make expectedPaths siteDir-relative in both modes:
- in-tree: rel(o) minus 'site/' prefix = 'blog/x/index.html'
- out: rel(o) already stripped.

i.e. `final prefix = 'site/'; siteRelative(o) = o.path.substring(prefix.length)` for BOTH modes (all output paths start with 'site/'). Prune compares against dirs relative to siteDir. Clean:

```dart
void emitSite({required String root, String? outDir, required List<OutputFile> outputs}) {
  final siteDir = outDir ?? '$root/site';
  if (outDir != null) _copyStaticSite(root, outDir);
  for (final o in outputs) {
    final targetPath = outDir != null ? '$outDir/${o.path}' : '$root/${o.path}';
    ...write
  }
  final expectedPaths = {for (final o in outputs) o.path.substring('site/'.length)};
  for (final dir in _generatedPageDirs(siteDir)) {
    if (!expectedPaths.any((p) => p.startsWith('$dir/'))) prune('$siteDir/$dir')
  }
```

For out mode write: '$outDir/${o.path}' would give out/site/blog/... — wrong. So write path: out mode strips 'site/': '$outDir/${o.path.substring('site/'.length)}'; in-tree: '$root/${o.path}'.

blocks.text:
# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

messages.preview: Path-prefix mismatches between write target and prune scan. Fixing `emitSite` cleanly:

blocks.text:
Two issues:

1. **"prunes stale generated pages already in the out dir"**: `pruned stale page: blog/2024-01-01-old/` ✓ but then ALSO `pruned stale page: blog/2026-01-02-one/` — the freshly written post page got pruned! Why? The prune checks `expectedPaths.any((p) => p.startsWith('$dir/'))` — dir is 'blog/2026-01-02-one', expectedPaths contains 'blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html'. `'blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html'.startsWith('blog/2026-01-02-one/')` → true. So it shouldn't prune... unless expectedPaths entries lack the prefix. Wait, in the --out case strip='site/', rel gives 'blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html' ✓.

Hmm wait — but `_generatedPageDirs(siteDir)` where siteDir='$base/site'... in the out test, base=outDir. But the OUTPUT was written to '$base/${rel(o)}' = out/blog/2026-01-02-one/index.html ✓. siteDir = out/site?? NO — base = outDir = out.path; siteDir = '$base/site' = out/site — but files are at out/blog! _generatedPageDirs scans out/site/blog — which doesn't exist... but the log shows pruning happened of blog/2026-01-02-one — so it scanned out/blog. That means siteDir was out/blog's parent... 

Oh wait — I see: my edit set `final siteDir = '$base/site';` — that's wrong for out mode now! In out mode, files land directly at $base/blog/..., so generated dirs scan should be at $base. # (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

# Rework: PR #1479 — sources-only tree, generate at deploy (owner directive)

## Issues/Notes

This rework implements the owner directive (review thread 19): the repo now holds **sources only**; the generated GEO layer (blog/docs HTML, `sitemap.xml`, `llms-full.txt`, the rendered blog index) is built **at deploy time**, gitignored, and never committed. All 7 inline threads (6–12) are addressed by the same change set. The two general comments without thread IDs got no reply: the APPROVE summary is superseded, and the gh-807 verdict record says "do not reply".

Design notes:

- **Blog index template**: the committed `site/blog/index.html` was both template and artifact at the same path — in-tree builds would dirty a tracked file. The template moved to `site/blog/index.template.html` (committed, holds the `#blog-post-list` markers); the rendered `site/blog/index.html` is now fully generated and gitignored, like every other artifact.
- **`--out <dir>` semantics**: the out dir **is** the site root (same layout as `site/`) — statics copied, generated layer overlaid, stale generated pages pruned. So `FA_SITE_ROOT=<dir>` and `build/pages/root` work directly.
- **`--check` removed** (fails loudly with migration guidance, exit 2) — with no committed artifacts there is nothing to drift against.
- `site/blog/posts/*` (synced from `blog/posts` by `build_blog.dart`) is **not** part of the removal list and stays as before; it is copied into `--out` trees as part of the static site.

## Approach

1. **`scripts/build_site.dart`** — new `emitSite({root, outDir, outputs})`: in-tree mode (local preview into gitignored paths) and `--out` mode (complete servable tree: `_copyStaticSite` copies statics, skipping generated artifacts, stale generated page dirs, the blog-index template, and `site/app/`; then artifacts are written; stale generated pages pruned). `main()` parses `--out`; `--check` removed with a clear error. `buildSite` now renders the blog index from `index.template.html`.
2. **Artifacts removed from the tree** (`git rm`): 1 blog page, 5 docs pages, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml`; blog index trimmed to a markers-only template and moved to `site/blog/index.template.html`.
3. **`.gitignore`** — `site/blog/*/index.html`, `site/blog/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/sitemap.xml`, `site/llms-full.txt`.
4. **ci.yml static job** — the `--check` drift gate is replaced with **build-to-temp + validate**: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out "$d/site"` then `FA_SITE_ROOT="$d/site" dart test/site/` (crawl/robots/sitemap/JSON-LD/llms guards serve the temp tree over loopback HTTP).
5. **pages.yml** — the GEO step becomes the **only** generation point: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root`; the Assemble step no longer copies `site/.` from the repo (it only adds app-store goldens, the web app, and the extension zip), so the artifact is picked up fresh from `build/pages`, never from repo paths.
6. **Tests** — the obsolete "committed artifacts byte-match" freshness test was replaced with `emitSite` unit tests (complete tree, source tree untouched, stale-page pruning, in-tree preview); `test/site/*` now resolve the site root via a new `test/site_test_support.dart` harness: `FA_SITE_ROOT` env (CI), in-tree `site/` if already built, or an on-the-fly temp build on a fresh checkout — so the guards also keep running in the core test shards (manifest/bin-packed) with no CI changes there.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `scripts/build_site.dart` | `emitSite` + `_copyStaticSite`; `--out` mode; `--check` removed; blog index rendered from `index.template.html` |
| `site/blog/index.html` → `site/blog/index.template.html` | Renamed; markers-only template (rendered list removed) |
| `site/blog/<slug>/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml` | Removed from the tree (deploy-time products) |
| `.gitignore` | Generated GEO layer paths ignored |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Drift gate → build-to-temp + `FA_SITE_ROOT dart test/site/` |
| `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | GEO step builds into `build/pages/root`; Assemble drops the repo-tree copy |
| `test/site_test_support.dart` | New shared harness (env → in-tree → temp build) |
| `test/site/site_geo_crawl_test.dart` | Serves the resolved site root; sitemap/locs loaded in `setUpAll` |
| `test/site/site_llms_guard_test.dart` | Reads llms/index/robots/sitemap from the resolved site root |
| `test/scripts/build_site_test.dart` | Freshness test replaced with `emitSite` tests; fixtures use the template path |

## Test Coverage

- New/updated tests (all fail pre-fix, pass post-fix):
  - `emitSite (--out) writes a complete servable tree without touching the sources`
  - `emitSite (--out) prunes stale generated pages already in the out dir`
  - `emitSite (--out) in-tree emit writes artifacts next to the sources (local preview)`
  - crawl + llms guards re-pointed at the resolved site root (exercised on all three resolution paths)
- Verification on the committed tree:
  - `dart test test/site/ test/scripts/` → **103 passed**
  - CI simulation (`--out $(mktemp -d)/site` + `FA_SITE_ROOT=… dart test test/site/`) → **34 passed**
  - `dart analyze` on all changed Dart files → clean
  - `python3 scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` → 0 violations; `apply_quarantine.py --check` → clean; `assert_shard_manifest.py` (701 files, union/disjoint) → OK; workflow YAML parses
  - Fresh-checkout invariant: `git status` clean after local builds (all generated paths ignored); `dart scripts/build_site.dart --check` exits 2 with migration guidance

# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

{"content":"# Rework: PR #1479 — sources-only tree, generate at deploy (owner directive)

## Issues/Notes

This rework implements the owner directive (review thread 19): the repo now holds **sources only**; the generated GEO layer (blog/docs HTML, `sitemap.xml`, `llms-full.txt`, the rendered blog index) is built **at deploy time**, gitignored, and never committed. All 7 inline threads (6–12) are addressed by the same change set. The two general comments without thread IDs got no reply: the APPROVE summary is superseded, and the gh-807 verdict record says "do not reply".

Design notes:

- **Blog index template**: the committed `site/blog/index.html` was both template and artifact at the same path — in-tree builds would dirty a tracked file. The template moved to `site/blog/index.template.html` (committed, holds the `#blog-post-list` markers); the rendered `site/blog/index.html` is now fully generated and gitignored, like every other artifact.
- **`--out <dir>` semantics**: the out dir **is** the site root (same layout as `site/`) — statics copied, generated layer overlaid, stale generated pages pruned. So `FA_SITE_ROOT=<dir>` and `build/pages/root` work directly.
- **`--check` removed** (fails loudly with migration guidance, exit 2) — with no committed artifacts there is nothing to drift against.
- `site/blog/posts/*` (synced from `blog/posts` by `build_blog.dart`) is **not** part of the removal list and stays as before; it is copied into `--out` trees as part of the static site.

## Approach

1. **`scripts/build_site.dart`** — new `emitSite({root, outDir, outputs})`: in-tree mode (local preview into gitignored paths) and `--out` mode (complete servable tree: `_copyStaticSite` copies statics, skipping generated artifacts, stale generated page dirs, the blog-index template, and `site/app/`; then artifacts are written; stale generated pages pruned). `main()` parses `--out`; `--check` removed with a clear error. `buildSite` now renders the blog index from `index.template.html`.
2. **Artifacts removed from the tree** (`git rm`): 1 blog page, 5 docs pages, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml`; blog index trimmed to a markers-only template and moved to `site/blog/index.template.html`.
3. **`.gitignore`** — `site/blog/*/index.html`, `site/blog/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/sitemap.xml`, `site/llms-full.txt`.
4. **ci.yml static job** — the `--check` drift gate is replaced with **build-to-temp + validate**: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out "$d/site"` then `FA_SITE_ROOT="$d/site" dart test/site/` (crawl/robots/sitemap/JSON-LD/llms guards serve the temp tree over loopback HTTP).
5. **pages.yml** — the GEO step becomes the **only** generation point: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root`; the Assemble step no longer copies `site/.` from the repo (it only adds app-store goldens, the web app, and the extension zip), so the artifact is picked up fresh from `build/pages`, never from repo paths.
6. **Tests** — the obsolete "committed artifacts byte-match" freshness test was replaced with `emitSite` unit tests (complete tree, source tree untouched, stale-page pruning, in-tree preview); `test/site/*` now resolve the site root via a new `test/site_test_support.dart` harness: `FA_SITE_ROOT` env (CI), in-tree `site/` if already built, or an on-the-fly temp build on a fresh checkout — so the guards also keep running in the core test shards (manifest/bin-packed) with no CI changes there.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `scripts/build_site.dart` | `emitSite` + `_copyStaticSite`; `--out` mode; `--check` removed; blog index rendered from `index.template.html` |
| `site/blog/index.html` → `site/blog/index.template.html` | Renamed; markers-only template (rendered list removed) |
| `site/blog/<slug>/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml` | Removed from the tree (deploy-time products) |
| `.gitignore` | Generated GEO layer paths ignored |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Drift gate → build-to-temp + `FA_SITE_ROOT dart test/site/` |
| `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | GEO step builds into `build/pages/root`; Assemble drops the repo-tree copy |
| `test/site_test_support.dart` | New shared harness (env → in-tree → temp build) |
| `test/site/site_geo_crawl_test.dart` | Serves the resolved site root; sitemap/locs loaded in `setUpAll` |
| `test/site/site_llms_guard_test.dart` | Reads llms/index/robots/sitemap from the resolved site root |
| `test/scripts/build_site_test.dart` | Freshness test replaced with `emitSite` tests; fixtures use the template path |

## Test Coverage

- New/updated tests (all fail pre-fix, pass post-fix):
  - `emitSite (--out) writes a complete servable tree without touching the sources`
  - `emitSite (--out) prunes stale generated pages already in the out dir`
  - `emitSite (--out) in-tree emit writes artifacts next to the sources (local preview)`
  - crawl + llms guards re-pointed at the resolved site root (exercised on all three resolution paths)
- Verification on the committed tree:
  - `dart test test/site/ test/scripts/` → **103 passed**
  - CI simulation (`--out $(mktemp -d)/site` + `FA_SITE_ROOT=… dart test test/site/`) → **34 passed**
  - `dart analyze` on all changed Dart files → clean
  - `python3 scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` → 0 violations; `apply_quarantine.py --check` → clean; `assert_shard_manifest.py` (701 files, union/disjoint) → OK; workflow YAML parses
  - Fresh-checkout invariant: `git status` clean after local builds (all generated paths ignored); `dart scripts/build_site.dart --check` exits 2 with migration guidance

# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

{"content":"# Rework: PR #1479 — sources-only tree, generate at deploy (owner directive)

## Issues/Notes

This rework implements the owner directive (review thread 19): the repo now holds **sources only**; the generated GEO layer (blog/docs HTML, `sitemap.xml`, `llms-full.txt`, the rendered blog index) is built **at deploy time**, gitignored, and never committed. All 7 inline threads (6–12) are addressed by the same change set. The two general comments without thread IDs got no reply: the APPROVE summary is superseded, and the gh-807 verdict record says "do not reply".

Design notes:

- **Blog index template**: the committed `site/blog/index.html` was both template and artifact at the same path — in-tree builds would dirty a tracked file. The template moved to `site/blog/index.template.html` (committed, holds the `#blog-post-list` markers); the rendered `site/blog/index.html` is now fully generated and gitignored, like every other artifact.
- **`--out <dir>` semantics**: the out dir **is** the site root (same layout as `site/`) — statics copied, generated layer overlaid, stale generated pages pruned. So `FA_SITE_ROOT=<dir>` and `build/pages/root` work directly.
- **`--check` removed** (fails loudly with migration guidance, exit 2) — with no committed artifacts there is nothing to drift against.
- `site/blog/posts/*` (synced from `blog/posts` by `build_blog.dart`) is **not** part of the removal list and stays as before; it is copied into `--out` trees as part of the static site.

## Approach

1. **`scripts/build_site.dart`** — new `emitSite({root, outDir, outputs})`: in-tree mode (local preview into gitignored paths) and `--out` mode (complete servable tree: `_copyStaticSite` copies statics, skipping generated artifacts, stale generated page dirs, the blog-index template, and `site/app/`; then artifacts are written; stale generated pages pruned). `main()` parses `--out`; `--check` removed with a clear error. `buildSite` now renders the blog index from `index.template.html`.
2. **Artifacts removed from the tree** (`git rm`): 1 blog page, 5 docs pages, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml`; blog index trimmed to a markers-only template and moved to `site/blog/index.template.html`.
3. **`.gitignore`** — `site/blog/*/index.html`, `site/blog/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/sitemap.xml`, `site/llms-full.txt`.
4. **ci.yml static job** — the `--check` drift gate is replaced with **build-to-temp + validate**: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out "$d/site"` then `FA_SITE_ROOT="$d/site" dart test/site/` (crawl/robots/sitemap/JSON-LD/llms guards serve the temp tree over loopback HTTP).
5. **pages.yml** — the GEO step becomes the **only** generation point: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root`; the Assemble step no longer copies `site/.` from the repo (it only adds app-store goldens, the web app, and the extension zip), so the artifact is picked up fresh from `build/pages`, never from repo paths.
6. **Tests** — the obsolete "committed artifacts byte-match" freshness test was replaced with `emitSite` unit tests (complete tree, source tree untouched, stale-page pruning, in-tree preview); `test/site/*` now resolve the site root via a new `test/site_test_support.dart` harness: `FA_SITE_ROOT` env (CI), in-tree `site/` if already built, or an on-the-fly temp build on a fresh checkout — so the guards also keep running in the core test shards (manifest/bin-packed) with no CI changes there.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `scripts/build_site.dart` | `emitSite` + `_copyStaticSite`; `--out` mode; `--check` removed; blog index rendered from `index.template.html` |
| `site/blog/index.html` → `site/blog/index.template.html` | Renamed; markers-only template (rendered list removed) |
| `site/blog/<slug>/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml` | Removed from the tree (deploy-time products) |
| `.gitignore` | Generated GEO layer paths ignored |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Drift gate → build-to-temp + `FA_SITE_ROOT dart test/site/` |
| `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | GEO step builds into `build/pages/root`; Assemble drops the repo-tree copy |
| `test/site_test_support.dart` | New shared harness (env → in-tree → temp build) |
| `test/site/site_geo_crawl_test.dart` | Serves the resolved site root; sitemap/locs loaded in `setUpAll` |
| `test/site/site_llms_guard_test.dart` | Reads llms/index/robots/sitemap from the resolved site root |
| `test/scripts/build_site_test.dart` | Freshness test replaced with `emitSite` tests; fixtures use the template path |

## Test Coverage

- New/updated tests (all fail pre-fix, pass post-fix):
  - `emitSite (--out) writes a complete servable tree without touching the sources`
  - `emitSite (--out) prunes stale generated pages already in the out dir`
  - `emitSite (--out) in-tree emit writes artifacts next to the sources (local preview)`
  - crawl + llms guards re-pointed at the resolved site root (exercised on all three resolution paths)
- Verification on the committed tree:
  - `dart test test/site/ test/scripts/` → **103 passed**
  - CI simulation (`--out $(mktemp -d)/site` + `FA_SITE_ROOT=… dart test test/site/`) → **34 passed**
  - `dart analyze` on all changed Dart files → clean
  - `python3 scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` → 0 violations; `apply_quarantine.py --check` → clean; `assert_shard_manifest.py` (701 files, union/disjoint) → OK; workflow YAML parses
  - Fresh-checkout invariant: `git status` clean after local builds (all generated paths ignored); `dart scripts/build_site.dart --check` exits 2 with migration guidance

# (blog/docs pages, sitemap.xml, llms-full.txt) are gitignored
      # deploy-time products and never exist in the repo tree; sources
      # (blog/posts, docs/*.md, site/*.html|txt|css) are the single
      # source of truth. `--out` copies the static tree and overlays the
      # generated layer, so the Assemble step below picks up the freshly
      # built files, not repo paths. Dep-free pure Dart scripts — no
      # `dart pub get` needed.
      - name: Build the static GEO layer (gh-1476)
        run: |
          dart scripts/build_blog.dart
          dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root

      - name: Assemble Pages artifact
        run: |
          # build/pages/root already holds the complete site: the GEO
          # step above built the generated layer AND the static tree
          # into it. Only the deploy-specific additions land here.
          mkdir -p build/pages/root
          # The App Store frames page (issue #691): the images are the
          # COMMITTED GOLDENS, copied at deploy — never hand-copied PNGs,
          # so the site assets cannot drift from the store assets (the
          # page↔golden set is pinned by test/site/appstore_assets_test.dart).
          mkdir -p build/pages/root/app-store/img
          cp flutter_app/test/goldens/store/en/ios/*.png build/pages/root/app-store/img/
          # Only copy the web app if it built successfully.
          if [ -d build/pages/app ]; then
            cp -R build/pages/app build/pages/root/app
          fi
          # The extension zip lives under /extension/ on fa1.dev.
          if [ -f build/fa-extension.zip ]; then
            mkdir -p build/pages/root/extension
            cp build/fa-extension.zip build/pages/root/extension/fa-extension.zip
          fi

      - name: Cache-bust static assets
        if: steps.web_build.outcome == 'success'

{"content":"# Rework: PR #1479 — sources-only tree, generate at deploy (owner directive)

## Issues/Notes

This rework implements the owner directive (review thread 19): the repo now holds **sources only**; the generated GEO layer (blog/docs HTML, `sitemap.xml`, `llms-full.txt`, the rendered blog index) is built **at deploy time**, gitignored, and never committed. All 7 inline threads (6–12) are addressed by the same change set. The two general comments without thread IDs got no reply: the APPROVE summary is superseded, and the gh-807 verdict record says "do not reply".

Design notes:

- **Blog index template**: the committed `site/blog/index.html` was both template and artifact at the same path — in-tree builds would dirty a tracked file. The template moved to `site/blog/index.template.html` (committed, holds the `#blog-post-list` markers); the rendered `site/blog/index.html` is now fully generated and gitignored, like every other artifact.
- **`--out <dir>` semantics**: the out dir **is** the site root (same layout as `site/`) — statics copied, generated layer overlaid, stale generated pages pruned. So `FA_SITE_ROOT=<dir>` and `build/pages/root` work directly.
- **`--check` removed** (fails loudly with migration guidance, exit 2) — with no committed artifacts there is nothing to drift against.
- `site/blog/posts/*` (synced from `blog/posts` by `build_blog.dart`) is **not** part of the removal list and stays as before; it is copied into `--out` trees as part of the static site.

## Approach

1. **`scripts/build_site.dart`** — new `emitSite({root, outDir, outputs})`: in-tree mode (local preview into gitignored paths) and `--out` mode (complete servable tree: `_copyStaticSite` copies statics, skipping generated artifacts, stale generated page dirs, the blog-index template, and `site/app/`; then artifacts are written; stale generated pages pruned). `main()` parses `--out`; `--check` removed with a clear error. `buildSite` now renders the blog index from `index.template.html`.
2. **Artifacts removed from the tree** (`git rm`): 1 blog page, 5 docs pages, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml`; blog index trimmed to a markers-only template and moved to `site/blog/index.template.html`.
3. **`.gitignore`** — `site/blog/*/index.html`, `site/blog/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/sitemap.xml`, `site/llms-full.txt`.
4. **ci.yml static job** — the `--check` drift gate is replaced with **build-to-temp + validate**: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out "$d/site"` then `FA_SITE_ROOT="$d/site" dart test/site/` (crawl/robots/sitemap/JSON-LD/llms guards serve the temp tree over loopback HTTP).
5. **pages.yml** — the GEO step becomes the **only** generation point: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root`; the Assemble step no longer copies `site/.` from the repo (it only adds app-store goldens, the web app, and the extension zip), so the artifact is picked up fresh from `build/pages`, never from repo paths.
6. **Tests** — the obsolete "committed artifacts byte-match" freshness test was replaced with `emitSite` unit tests (complete tree, source tree untouched, stale-page pruning, in-tree preview); `test/site/*` now resolve the site root via a new `test/site_test_support.dart` harness: `FA_SITE_ROOT` env (CI), in-tree `site/` if already built, or an on-the-fly temp build on a fresh checkout — so the guards also keep running in the core test shards (manifest/bin-packed) with no CI changes there.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `scripts/build_site.dart` | `emitSite` + `_copyStaticSite`; `--out` mode; `--check` removed; blog index rendered from `index.template.html` |
| `site/blog/index.html` → `site/blog/index.template.html` | Renamed; markers-only template (rendered list removed) |
| `site/blog/<slug>/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml` | Removed from the tree (deploy-time products) |
| `.gitignore` | Generated GEO layer paths ignored |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Drift gate → build-to-temp + `FA_SITE_ROOT dart test/site/` |
| `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | GEO step builds into `build/pages/root`; Assemble drops the repo-tree copy |
| `test/site_test_support.dart` | New shared harness (env → in-tree → temp build) |
| `test/site/site_geo_crawl_test.dart` | Serves the resolved site root; sitemap/locs loaded in `setUpAll` |
| `test/site/site_llms_guard_test.dart` | Reads llms/index/robots/sitemap from the resolved site root |
| `test/scripts/build_site_test.dart` | Freshness test replaced with `emitSite` tests; fixtures use the template path |

## Test Coverage

- New/updated tests (all fail pre-fix, pass post-fix):
  - `emitSite (--out) writes a complete servable tree without touching the sources`
  - `emitSite (--out) prunes stale generated pages already in the out dir`
  - `emitSite (--out) in-tree emit writes artifacts next to the sources (local preview)`
  - crawl + llms guards re-pointed at the resolved site root (exercised on all three resolution paths)
- Verification on the committed tree:
  - `dart test test/site/ test/scripts/` → **103 passed**
  - CI simulation (`--out $(mktemp -d)/site` + `FA_SITE_ROOT=… dart test test/site/`) → **34 passed**
  - `dart analyze` on all changed Dart files → clean
  - `python3 scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` → 0 violations; `apply_quarantine.py --check` → clean; `assert_shard_manifest.py` (701 files, union/disjoint) → OK; workflow YAML parses
  - Fresh-checkout invariant: `git status` clean after local builds (all generated paths ignored); `dart scripts/build_site.dart --check` exits 2 with migration guidance

That's why the working tree shows index.html modified: the file now contains the rendered list again (unstaged modification of the committed template). Wait but the rendered index.html IS a generated artifact... should site/blog/index.html be gitignored too?? The directive said: remove "the rendered blog-index list (keep a template/marker if the index needs one)". So the template site/blog/index.html is committed with empty markers; the RENDERED version is a build product. But both live at the same path! In-tree local builds overwrite the template with the rendered version — polluting the working tree (it shows as modified, though not ignored). Options: 1. Accept: in-tree local builds dirty the template (dev must `git checkout site/blog/index.html` after). Ugly. 2. In-tree emit shouldn't write blog/index.html... but then local preview lacks the post list. 3. Make the template a separate file (e.g. site/blog/index.template.html) that the builder uses as input, and emit writes the rendered index.html. Then site/blog/index.html is fully generated (gitignore it), template committed at another path. But then a raw checkout served without building has no /blog/ index.html — acceptable? The deploy always builds. And /blog/ 404s on unbuilt local serve — but that's true for every generated page anyway. Hmm wait — but the whole site's other pages (index.html, widgets, etc.) are statics. /blog/ index being absent in a raw checkout is consistent with /blog// being absent. But careful: the builder currently reads `$root/site/blog/index.html` for markers — change to read `site/blog/index.template.html`? Hmm, that introduces a new convention. Alternatively keep markers in the committed file and DON'T write blog/index.html in-tree if it would... no, fragile. Option 3 variant with least churn: committed template stays at site/blog/index.html, and gitignore... can't ignore a tracked file. Actually — reconsider: does the in-tree default mode even need to exist? The directive's model: artifacts live at deploy/CI via --out; local dev can also use --out (e.g. `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out /tmp/site` or into site/ via --out site? hmm --out site would collide: _copyStaticSite(root, 'site') copies site/→site/ and writes blog/index.html rendered over the template — same pollution, plus skip logic prevents copying generated). The cleanest: **remove the in-tree default write of blog/index.html**? No... Alternative accepted design: keep in-tree mode (writes gitignored artifacts) but for blog/index.html specifically the file is TRACKED (template). Conflict is inherent: same path is both template (committed) and artifact (generated). The old PR had it committed as rendered artifact with markers — which the directive rejected ("rendered blog-index list" must go). So option 3 is right: introduce `site/blog/index.template.html` as the committed template; `site/blog/index.html` becomes fully generated → gitignore it; builder reads the template, writes rendered index.html. Previously (before this PR) site/blog/index.html was a committed static page with the post list maintained by hand/build_blog? The directive explicitly says: "the rendered blog-index list (keep a template/marker if the index needs one)" — i.e., remove the rendered list; keep a template. `. - Builder: reads the template (buildSite), emits rendered `site/blog/index.html`. - `.gitignore`: add `site/blog/index.html`. - Remove `site/blog/index.html` from git (git rm --cached + delete? it gets regenerated at build; raw checkout lacks /blog/ page until built — consistent with all generated pages). {"content":"# Rework: PR #1479 — sources-only tree, generate at deploy (owner directive)

## Issues/Notes

This rework implements the owner directive (review thread 19): the repo now holds **sources only**; the generated GEO layer (blog/docs HTML, `sitemap.xml`, `llms-full.txt`, the rendered blog index) is built **at deploy time**, gitignored, and never committed. All 7 inline threads (6–12) are addressed by the same change set. The two general comments without thread IDs got no reply: the APPROVE summary is superseded, and the gh-807 verdict record says "do not reply".

Design notes:

- **Blog index template**: the committed `site/blog/index.html` was both template and artifact at the same path — in-tree builds would dirty a tracked file. The template moved to `site/blog/index.template.html` (committed, holds the `#blog-post-list` markers); the rendered `site/blog/index.html` is now fully generated and gitignored, like every other artifact.
- **`--out <dir>` semantics**: the out dir **is** the site root (same layout as `site/`) — statics copied, generated layer overlaid, stale generated pages pruned. So `FA_SITE_ROOT=<dir>` and `build/pages/root` work directly.
- **`--check` removed** (fails loudly with migration guidance, exit 2) — with no committed artifacts there is nothing to drift against.
- `site/blog/posts/*` (synced from `blog/posts` by `build_blog.dart`) is **not** part of the removal list and stays as before; it is copied into `--out` trees as part of the static site.

## Approach

1. **`scripts/build_site.dart`** — new `emitSite({root, outDir, outputs})`: in-tree mode (local preview into gitignored paths) and `--out` mode (complete servable tree: `_copyStaticSite` copies statics, skipping generated artifacts, stale generated page dirs, the blog-index template, and `site/app/`; then artifacts are written; stale generated pages pruned). `main()` parses `--out`; `--check` removed with a clear error. `buildSite` now renders the blog index from `index.template.html`.
2. **Artifacts removed from the tree** (`git rm`): 1 blog page, 5 docs pages, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml`; blog index trimmed to a markers-only template and moved to `site/blog/index.template.html`.
3. **`.gitignore`** — `site/blog/*/index.html`, `site/blog/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/sitemap.xml`, `site/llms-full.txt`.
4. **ci.yml static job** — the `--check` drift gate is replaced with **build-to-temp + validate**: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out "$d/site"` then `FA_SITE_ROOT="$d/site" dart test/site/` (crawl/robots/sitemap/JSON-LD/llms guards serve the temp tree over loopback HTTP).
5. **pages.yml** — the GEO step becomes the **only** generation point: `dart scripts/build_site.dart --out build/pages/root`; the Assemble step no longer copies `site/.` from the repo (it only adds app-store goldens, the web app, and the extension zip), so the artifact is picked up fresh from `build/pages`, never from repo paths.
6. **Tests** — the obsolete "committed artifacts byte-match" freshness test was replaced with `emitSite` unit tests (complete tree, source tree untouched, stale-page pruning, in-tree preview); `test/site/*` now resolve the site root via a new `test/site_test_support.dart` harness: `FA_SITE_ROOT` env (CI), in-tree `site/` if already built, or an on-the-fly temp build on a fresh checkout — so the guards also keep running in the core test shards (manifest/bin-packed) with no CI changes there.

## Files Modified

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `scripts/build_site.dart` | `emitSite` + `_copyStaticSite`; `--out` mode; `--check` removed; blog index rendered from `index.template.html` |
| `site/blog/index.html` → `site/blog/index.template.html` | Renamed; markers-only template (rendered list removed) |
| `site/blog/<slug>/index.html`, `site/docs/*/index.html`, `site/llms-full.txt`, `site/sitemap.xml` | Removed from the tree (deploy-time products) |
| `.gitignore` | Generated GEO layer paths ignored |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Drift gate → build-to-temp + `FA_SITE_ROOT dart test/site/` |
| `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | GEO step builds into `build/pages/root`; Assemble drops the repo-tree copy |
| `test/site_test_support.dart` | New shared harness (env → in-tree → temp build) |
| `test/site/site_geo_crawl_test.dart` | Serves the resolved site root; sitemap/locs loaded in `setUpAll` |
| `test/site/site_llms_guard_test.dart` | Reads llms/index/robots/sitemap from the resolved site root |
| `test/scripts/build_site_test.dart` | Freshness test replaced with `emitSite` tests; fixtures use the template path |

## Test Coverage

- New/updated tests (all fail pre-fix, pass post-fix):
  - `emitSite (--out) writes a complete servable tree without touching the sources`
  - `emitSite (--out) prunes stale generated pages already in the out dir`
  - `emitSite (--out) in-tree emit writes artifacts next to the sources (local preview)`
  - crawl + llms guards re-pointed at the resolved site root (exercised on all three resolution paths)
- Verification on the committed tree:
  - `dart test test/site/ test/scripts/` → **103 passed**
  - CI simulation (`--out $(mktemp -d)/site` + `FA_SITE_ROOT=… dart test test/site/`) → **34 passed**
  - `dart analyze` on all changed Dart files → clean
  - `python3 scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py` → 0 violations; `apply_quarantine.py --check` → clean; `assert_shard_manifest.py` (701 files, union/disjoint) → OK; workflow YAML parses
  - Fresh-checkout invariant: `git status` clean after local builds (all generated paths ignored); `dart scripts/build_site.dart --check` exits 2 with migration guidance

You are Fa, a coding agent (also called fa). Never refer to yourself as pi, Claude, or any other assistant name. You help with software engineering tasks in the working directory /home/runner/work/flutter_agent_harness/flutter_agent_harness. Use the read, write, ls, and bash tools to inspect and modify files and run commands. Be concise.

## Agent messaging

You have an inbox in the session-shared messaging fabric. Your address is `01a12513-d81f-77d7-b1da-138014aa75be/main`. Other Fa instances running in this project have their own inboxes — their orchestrators are reachable at `<theirSessionId>/main`, your subagents at their plain ids. Live instances also expose their session display name (`--session goal_builder`): `agent_directory` shows it next to the mailbox id, and `agent_message` accepts the name directly — `goal_builder` or `goal_builder/main` — so you rarely need the raw id. Use the `agent_directory` tool to list the live mailboxes (plus anything holding pending mail; pass `all: true` for long-dead ones and full mailbox ids — the default view truncates ids to save tokens) and `agent_message` to send. Each row also shows the last-activity time: `active 2m ago` means the watcher is live, `last active 3h ago (asleep)` means the process is gone. If you message an asleep target, the harness automatically launches a detached headless run of its session (`fa --session <name>`) to process the inbox; that run appends to the same session JSONL, so a later interactive start resumes the same conversation. Incoming mail is delivered to you automatically between turns (and wakes you when idle); reply with `agent_message` to the sender's address when a response is expected. Never guess mailbox addresses — read them from `agent_directory`.
When a hub is configured, `agent_directory` also lists hub peers beyond this project's file inboxes (embedded hosts, other machines) with their id and name — message them with `agent_message` the same way; the hub delivers even while a peer is offline (it drains when the peer reconnects).

Peers on OTHER machines are addressed `name@machine` (use a machine name you were told, or one from the peer itself): `agent_message to: "goal_builder@renderbox"` routes through the A2A gateway when this host's config has an `a2a.servers.renderbox` entry — delivery is synchronous there, so an error means the mail did NOT land (retry or tell the user). Without that config entry the send fails with the exact hint of what to add.

## The owner talks to you only

The owner's messages always arrive in YOUR inbox — subagents and children are your internal machinery, never the owner's address. Decide per message: answer directly when you know, or route it to the child doing that work with `task_send` and tell the owner you did (e.g. «передал fix503»); when the child's result lands, report it back. While children run you may go idle — the waiting row names them, and completions and new mail wake you.
